title: Dictionary and Wordlist Locations
description: Common wordlist paths and generation methods
detail:
Included with Kali: /usr/share/wordlists/ (decompress rockyou.txt.gz, dirb/common.txt, dirbuster/, wfuzz/)
Directory scanning: start with common.txt → directory-list-2.3-medium; for Chinese-language projects, consider suffixes/patterns such as admin/login/api/guangdong
Parameter fuzzing: Burp parameter name dictionaries, arjun's built-in list
Usernames: generate from target-domain information (pinyin rules such as zhangsan/zs/zhang.san) + common admin/test/root/guest
Password mutations: company abbreviation + year (corp2026), admin@123, P@ssw0rd
Generation: use cewl to collect keywords from pages into a password list; hashcat --stdout rule mutations
Keep a few lightweight dictionaries in the repository's dicts/ as an offline fallback for assessment environments. NOTE (2026-10-17): seclists Passwords/IOCs were REMOVED from the image to save space — surviving wordlists live under /usr/share/wordlists/ and dirb common.txt; ls the path before relying on it. If no password list exists, hand-craft a targeted one from target-page keywords (company/site names + years).
